name: Scanlines
summary: Thin dark horizontal lines across the frame with a slow rolling brighter band; for CRT and retro looks.

params.name: gap
params.note: spacing between lines in px, 4 to 40

params.name: seed
params.note: change to give a separate instance its own id

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
